newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Euro.NM says 37 companies listed after strong H1.
newsitem.headline: Euro.NM says 37 companies listed after strong H1.

text.p: The Euro.NM small capitalisation market has exceeded all expectations since its launch last year and now has a total capitalisation of 144.7 billion francs ($3.9 billion) and 37 listed companies, Euro.NM Belgium said on Monday.
It said in a statement 20 companies had listed their shares on Euro.NM in the first half of 1997, increasing its portfolio by 80 percent on average in value since the start of 1997.
It said Euro.NM was aiming for an annual listing of 90 new companies -- 30 in France, 30 in Germany, 10 in Belgium and 20 in the Netherlands.
This would bring the total number at 450 within five years.

It said that its four members -- Le Nouveau Marche in Paris, Euro.NM Belgium, NMAX (New Market Amsterdam Exchange) and the German Neuer Markt -- had already approved a series of rules for their trading and listing procedures.
They also have a joint marketing strategy and are due to inaugurate a common data feed in October. They also want to interconnect the four market platforms to enable cross membership.
Le Nouveau Marche and Euro.NM Belgium will link their platforms by the end of this year. NMAX will be linked in early 1998 and the Neuer Markt late next year.
An Euro.NM index is planned for the end of 1997.
-- Bert Lauwers, Brussels Newsroom +32 2 287 6815, Fax +32 2 230 7710 ($ = 37.52 Belgian Francs)
